blocks.text: Five and up with a noun

d) **ПЯТЬ**, **ШЕСТЬ**, **СЕМЬ** etc. After all other numerals (**пять**, **шесть**, **семь**, etc.) as well as after all compound numbers with 5, 6, 7, etc. as last word, the noun is in the genitive plural: *5 уроков, 35 уроков; 10 страниц, 40 страниц; 11 слов, 111 слов.*
Note — 1) Russian compound numerals are never connected by **и**: hundred and five — **сто пять**.
Declension of 5–20 and 30
Numerals ending in soft sign (5–20 and 30) are declined like feminine nouns ending in soft sign (**ночь**, **площадь** etc.).
Note that the Accusative of both animate and inanimate is always the same as the Nominative: *Я вижу пять новых самолётов. Я вижу пять новых студентов.*
The accusative case of compound numerals ending in 1, 2, 3, 4

The word **один** follows the rule of animate and inanimate nouns even when it appears at the end of a compound numeral: *Я вижу двадцать один самолёт. Я вижу двадцать одного студента.* However, **два** (**две**), **три**, **четыре** appearing at the end of the compound numerals do not follow the above pattern in the Accusative case. Their Accusative (both animate and inanimate) is usually the same as the Nominative: *Я вижу двадцать два самолёта. Я вижу двадцать два студента. Я знаю тридцать пять человек.*
Declension of 50, 60, 70, 80
Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
Declension of 40, 90 and 100

blocks.text: Declension of compound numerals

rows: двадцать один танк / двадцать одного студента

blocks.text: Note that each component of a compound numeral is declined separately.
DLI, Lesson 71.
Cardinal numerals

**Тысяча** (fem.) and **миллион** (masc.) are used and declined as nouns and have both singular and plural forms: *одна тысяча, две тысячи, пять тысяч; один миллион, два миллиона, пять миллионов.* **Тысяча** and **миллион** are followed in all cases by the Genitive plural of the noun and its qualifier. **Тысяча** is quite commonly pronounced (but never spelled) like «**тыща**». Five hundred and fifty five = **пятьсот пятьдесят пять**.
DLI, Lesson 69.
Declension of 200–900
Both parts of these numerals are declined separately but are written together. Note that the second part has plural endings (**-стам**, **-стами**, **-стах**).
DLI, Lesson 72.
Numerical approximation by reverse word order
Note that the preposition (if used) always remains before the numeral:

items: Я вернусь через три дня. — Я вернусь дня через три.
Он ложится спать в 12 часов. — Он ложится спать часов в 12.

Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: There are ten decades in a century.
exercises.why: **десять → десяти** (gen.: из + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.prompt: Kylian Mbappé is only 19 years old.
exercises.why: **девятнадцать лет** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (год → лет, irregular).

exercises.prompt: This train is made up of seven cars.
exercises.why: **семь вагонов** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (вагон → вагонов).

exercises.q: Детям до ___ (шестнадцать) включительно вход в театр воспрещён.
exercises.prompt: Children who are sixteen years old or younger may not enter the theater.
exercises.why: **шестнадцать → шестнадцати** (gen.: до + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.prompt: Can you break a five dollar bill?
exercises.why: **пять долларов** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (доллар → долларов).

exercises.prompt: Mary was chosen from among 500 applicants.
exercises.why: **пятьсот → пятисот** (gen.: из + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.
**сорок → сорока** (gen.: agrees with лет (genitive plural)). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.prompt: I only have a hundred rubles.
exercises.why: **сто рублей** — round tens and hundreds (30, 50, 100, 800…) take the genitive plural (рубль → рублей).
**девять → девяти** (gen.: с + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.q: Ещё семь ___ (день) и я увижу мою сладенькую снова.
exercises.prompt: Just seven more days — then I'll see my sweetie again.
exercises.why: **семь дней** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (день → дней).

exercises.prompt: He's not the brightest guy in the world.
exercises.why: **семь → семи** (gen.: agrees with пядей (genitive plural)). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.prompt: My great grandfather is over 100 years old.
exercises.why: **сто → ста** (gen.: agrees with лет (genitive plural)). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.q: Я заплатил за эту книгу восемьсот ___ (иена).
exercises.prompt: I paid 800 yen for this book.
exercises.why: **восемьсот иен** — round tens and hundreds (30, 50, 100, 800…) take the genitive plural (иена → иен).

exercises.prompt: This is an opera in five acts.
exercises.why: **пять → пяти** (prep.: в + prepositional). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.q: Следующий поезд «Синкансэн» отходит ровно в девять ___ (час).
exercises.prompt: The next Shinkansen train leaves at just nine o'clock.
exercises.why: **девять часов** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (час → часов).

exercises.prompt: Only three of the twelve islands are inhabited.
exercises.why: **двенадцать → двенадцати** (gen.: из + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.prompt: There are fifty states in the United States.
exercises.why: **пятьдесят штатов** — round tens and hundreds (30, 50, 100, 800…) take the genitive plural (штат → штатов).
